text:
maria (People Ops): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands — leaving this thread open for any follow-ups about remote/hybrid logistics, travel, offsites, and workspace policies. Drop quick questions and we'll answer in-thread. :wave:

jamal (Eng): quick q — is there a new per-person cap for team offsites next quarter, or same as last year?
alex (Eng Manager): seconded. also, do we still need manager + finance approvals for >$5k events?
sarah (Finance): short answer: approvals still required for >$5k. We're updating the guideline doc with tiered caps this week. Will post link. :memo:
maria (People Ops): correct — process unchanged for now. Higher-level change: pilot of flexible per-head allowances for small teams (<=12) starting Q3. We expect to announce pilot details by mid-July.
people-ops-bot: https://intranet.redwood/ops/travel-policy (latest policy draft)
james (Designer): for the pilot, any restrictions on remote-first offsites vs in-office-only ones? wondering about venue requirements (insurance, accessibility).
nina (Ops): venues still need basic liability coverage and an accessibility checklist. Ops can pre-vet vendors if you ping ops@redwood with dates. For small team pilots we can be flexible on venue type.
jamal (Eng): thanks — also, if someone needs a visa letter for travel, what's the turnaround?
sarah (Finance): standard turnaround is 3 business days once you submit travel request + estimated dates. If urgent write "urgent" in the request and cc your manager. Receipts still required for reimbursements.
maria (People Ops): FYI short excerpt from the travel FAQ: ```Reimbursements: submit receipts within 30 days. Per diem applies for domestic overnight travel ($75/day) and international per diem varies by country. Manager approval required for exceptions.```
alex (Eng Manager): thanks — is Concur still the booking tool or are we moving to a new vendor?
sarah (Finance): Concur remains the default for now. We're evaluating a simpler UX alternative for smaller bookings; won't change mid-quarter.
james (Designer): one more: desk reservations for satellite hubs — any change to the 2-week advance rule?
nina (Ops): no change to the advance window; we might pilot same-day check-ins at one hub in August. We'll run a sign-up trial and share details next week.
maria (People Ops): great thread. We'll compile these answers into a short all-hands follow-up doc and post in #announcements. If you need a one-off exception (e.g., urgent visas or last-minute venue book), DM me or tag @people-ops and we'll triage. :sparkles:
